paragraphs.source_en: Getting People on Your Side might have been, in other times, the church, education, the family, the greatest impact now is business. Everywhere one looks, it seems to me that short-term thinking in business is the greatest impact on our culture. And that’s leadership, because it’s certainly educating kids to believe there’s nothing between winning and losing.... Short-term thinking is the societal disease of our time.” Other leaders agreed with Lear, noting that if companies devoted as much time and attention to product quality as they do to trying to skirt laws and buy ofﬁcials, their bottom lines would probably improve. While studies of the relationship between corporate ethics and corporate bottom lines have been inconclusive (most show there is no relationship), Jim Burke pointed out that ethical corporations can be consistently proﬁtable, as Johnson & Johnson was on his watch.
